blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) suspended the implementation of the expanded number coding scheme on Monday, Nov. 30. This is amid the observation of Bonifacio Day, which is declared a regular holiday under President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s Proclamation No. 1006.“Suspendido ang pagpapatupad ng Expanded Number Coding Scheme sa Lunes, Nobyembre 30, 2026, isang regular holiday upang gunitain ang kabayanihan ni Gat. Andres Bonifacio,” the MMDA said in an advisory. (The implementation of the Expanded Number Coding Scheme is suspended on Monday, November 30, 2026, a regular holiday to commemorate the heroism of Gat.
